- But if " giving up on being able to draw enso" = " no longer * care about* drawing enso" ( i.e., no longer attached to the outcome), that's right. 

The phrasing " gave up on being able to draw an enso" is ambiguous. In Zen context, " being able to" implies * skill* or * mastery*. So " giving up on being able" would mean " no longer trying to * master* enso drawing"— which is exactly the point.
